description: Return an EASA rule by its reference (for example 145.A.30(e), CAMO.A.305, ORO.GEN.200, FCL.010) with its text, AMC and GM, the regulation, the EAR revision date and the page URL. A rule published point by point lists its points to request next. If several regulations use the reference (such as Article 2), the matches are listed: pass `regulation` to choose one.

regulation.description: Regulation slug from list_regulations, only needed when a reference is shared

name: get_rule
title: Get an EASA rule by reference
